text: The project improved water management for approximately 8,000 households across 50 villages, enhancing the management of 16,000–16,100 hectares of agricultural land. It benefited at least 10,000 people through improved flood management, reduced flash floods, and reliable water supply for dry-season cropping. The initiative also led to social benefits, such as reduced migration, and included targeted training for women.

metadata.solution_name: Greater Mekong Subregion Flood and Drought Risk Management and Mitigation Project (Cambodia component)
